grammar.q: This jacket is ___ than the one I saw yesterday.
grammar.tip: 两者比较用比较级 -er：cheaper than… «比…便宜»。

grammar.q: Could I get a ___? It's 20% off today.
grammar.tip: get a discount 拿到折扣；20% off 表示打八折。

grammar.q: Can I ___ this shirt for a larger size?
grammar.tip: exchange A for B 用 A 换 B；情态动词 can 后接动词原形。

listen.t: Do you have this in a bigger size?
o: Do you have this in a bigger size?
Do you have this in a smaller size?

listen.t: I'd like a refund, please. Here's my receipt.
o: I'd like a refund, please. Here's my receipt.
I'd like to exchange this, please.
I'd like to pay by card.

speak.t: Excuse me, how much is this sweater?
speak.hint: how much 重读，is 与 this 可轻微连读

speak.t: It's a bit expensive. Is there any discount?
speak.hint: a bit 轻快带过，any discount 语调上扬表询问

grammar.q: The report claims that fake news ___ rapidly on social media.
grammar.tip: 主语 fake news 为单数，一般现在时动词加 -s；此处陈述普遍事实。
否定副词 rarely 置于句首引起部分倒装：have I seen。

grammar.q: The article, ___ was published last week, sparked wide debate.
grammar.tip: 非限制性定语从句（有逗号）只能用 which，不用 that。

listen.t: Social media shapes public opinion more than traditional newspapers.
o: Social media shapes public opinion more than traditional newspapers.
Social media reflects public opinion like newspapers.
Traditional newspapers have more influence than social media.

listen.t: We should check whether the source is credible before sharing.
o: We should check whether the source is credible before sharing.
We should share the news before checking the source.
We should trust everything we read online.

speak.t: I think the media plays a powerful role in shaping opinions.
speak.hint: plays a powerful role 连贯朗读，shaping 重读

speak.t: Not everything that goes viral is accurate.
speak.hint: not everything 重音落在 everything，句尾下降

B2.title: Environment & Sustainability · 环境与可持续

grammar.q: If governments ___ action earlier, the damage would be less severe.
grammar.tip: 对过去的虚拟：If + had done，主句 would do/would be。

grammar.q: More and more households ___ solar panels to cut emissions.
grammar.tip: households 是复数主语，be 动词用 are；现在进行时表正在发生的趋势。

grammar.q: It is high time we ___ plastic waste seriously.
grammar.tip: It is high time (that) + 过去式，表示«该是认真对待…的时候了»。

listen.t: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper than coal in many countries.
o: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper than coal in many countries.
Coal is becoming cheaper than renewable energy.
Renewable energy is banned in many countries.

listen.t: Small daily habits can make a real difference to the planet.
o: Small daily habits can make a real difference to the planet.
Daily habits make no difference to the planet.
Only factories can change the planet.

speak.t: Reducing plastic waste starts with small everyday choices.
speak.hint: 动名词 Reducing 开头重读，choices 句尾自然下降

speak.t: I try to recycle and take public transport whenever I can.
speak.hint: whenever I can 轻快带过，不逐字重读

C1.title: Nuance & Rhetoric · 精准表达与修辞

grammar.q: Not until the debate ended ___ how persuasive she had been.
grammar.tip: Not until 置于句首，主句部分倒装：did I realize。

grammar.q: His argument was elegant, ___ somewhat detached from reality.
grammar.tip: if 表«虽然/即便»的让步：elegant, if somewhat detached 虽优雅却略脱离现实。

grammar.q: Were the data ___ complete, the conclusion would still be debatable.
grammar.tip: even if 表«即使»；倒装省略 if 后保留 even。

listen.t: The distinction between implying and stating is where persuasion begins.
o: The distinction between implying and stating is where persuasion begins.
Stating is more persuasive than implying.

listen.t: A single word, chosen poorly, can undermine an entire argument.
o: A single word, chosen poorly, can undermine an entire argument.
A well-chosen word can undermine an argument.
Arguments don't depend on word choice.

speak.t: To put it succinctly, precision beats volume in any debate.
speak.hint: to put it succinctly 插入语稍慢，主句语调自然下降

speak.t: I take your point, though I'd frame the question differently.
speak.hint: though 前稍作停顿，differently 重读收尾
